At the end there she seemed more depressed than angry. Have I misjudged the whole situation?
Maybe she’s just afraid of losing us? 
Well, it’s true that if we leave we will probably never come back here again. It would be just too risky. TSA agents are more thorough the other way around, they could figure out that {f_botName} is a bot. It would spell trouble.
I need to think of a way to make everyone content…
